ep01.description: A large outdoor medical university graduation ceremony in a sports stadium during bright daylight. Crowds of graduates in gowns and caps fill the tiered seating, cheering and applauding. Banners and a festive stage in the distance. Warm sunlight, celebratory bright color palette, shallow depth of field on the crowd.

A formal graduation ceremony podium and stage with a microphone at the front, university crest backdrop, floral arrangements, and rows of seated dignitaries. Polished wooden lectern, warm stage lighting, formal and prestigious atmosphere.

A quiet corner of the graduation stadium away from the crowd, with concrete pillars and railings, scattered graduates in the background out of focus. Daylight with soft shadows, intimate and slightly tense mood for private conversation.

A luxurious high-rise penthouse at night, floor-to-ceiling glass walls overlooking a glittering city skyline. Cold neon light slices through the darkness, staining surfaces in electric blue and magenta. Sleek modern furniture, marble and dark wood, oppressive and dangerously seductive atmosphere.

ep03.description: An elegant dinner setting inside a luxury penthouse at night. A refined dining table at the center bathed in soft flickering candlelight, silver cloches on plates, fine tableware. Warm golden glow contrasting with the dark city night beyond the windows, intimate yet tense atmosphere.

ep04.description: The living room of a luxury penthouse with a large leather sofa as the centerpiece, facing floor-to-ceiling windows with a city view. Warm ambient lighting, tasteful decor, plush rugs, an upscale and comfortable domestic atmosphere.
